rationale: Several papers provide substantive new evidence regarding the role of binary neutron star mergers and other potential sites like collapsars in r-process nucleosynthesis, but the question remains partially addressed as no single site is definitively confirmed as the sole contributor. Papers 2605.23554, 2402.08214, 2302.09226, 2402.03696, and 2605.20596 contribute to this ongoing investigation.
